brief:
The mayor of Hebron said Israeli occupation forces issued demolition notices for a residential building and two structures containing 65 apartments in the Ras al-Joura and Farsh al-Hawa neighborhoods of the city, Maan Wire reported. The notices threaten to displace dozens of Palestinian families from their homes in the occupied West Bank city.

No timeline for the demolitions was specified in the mayor's statement, though such orders typically precede enforcement by weeks or months.
title: Israeli military orders demolition of Hebron homes housing 65 apartments
